spectral_cause_trace.hypothesis: FeatureStacks v3 were built via build_usgs_feature_dataset → build_feature_stack. Prior docs (ai_model_selection_discovery.md, production_qualification.md) report GEE spectral IAM failures yielding nodata spectral bands. This audit verifies corpus-wide all-nodata rates; root cause attribution to GEE IAM is REPORTED from those docs unless live GEE call is re-run (out of scope / may require credentials).

absence_audit.methodology_reported: docs/SOURCE_PSEUDO_ABSENCE_METHODOLOGY.md — 15 km full-inventory exclusion; 15–100 km offset from positives
absence_audit.contamination_risk: Unmapped landslides outside inventory remain possible; buffer reduces but does not eliminate false negatives in absence class
absence_audit.proposed_rule: Reject absence candidates within 20 km of any USGS CONUS inventory point (stricter than v3 15 km); document in rebuild manifest

leakage_audit.location_encoding_risk: latitude/longitude not in feature channels; spatial block id not a model input — VERIFIED channel list

what_model_could_learn.usable_signal: Terrain channels (0–6) generally finite with edge nodata; gravity often finite; magnetics often near-constant per chip

what_model_could_learn.label_limitation: Point/pseudo-absence tiles support susceptibility ranking, not scar detection
